title: What It Really Costs to Own a Mustang GTD
description:
The Ford Mustang GTD starts at three hundred twenty-seven thousand, nine hundred sixty dollars, with fees and tax. You cannot simply walk into a dealership and buy one. Ford makes buyers apply, and the articles we found say selected buyers cannot sell for at least two years. Its window sticker shows a gas-guzzler tax and twelve miles per gallon. This is what it really costs to own a Ford Mustang GTD, and what the published sources do not tell us. We will go through the price, the options, the fees, the application, the two-year rule, the fuel, and the little that is published about running costs. Every figure comes from a published source, named in the video and listed in the description. Where we do the maths ourselves, we say so. And where a source gives no figure, we will not invent one, because on the GTD that happens a lot.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
